root_cause.technical: PayGate rolled api.paygate.example edge nodes to a new TLS chain (Issuing CA G3 under new Root R2) between 09:04 and 09:24 UTC. payment-adapter uses a custom baked JKS truststore containing only Root R1/G2, so new handshakes fail with PKIX path building failed. payment-adapter returns 502, checkout-service propagates it, api-gateway shows the 502 spike in Datadog.
root_cause.organizational: Vendor notices (Aug 24, Sep 24) went to a shared mailbox owned by an employee who left in June; offboarding ticket VEN-52 closed 'no action'. No process routes vendor notices to on-call.
latent_factors: truststore baked into image, refresh never automated (PAY-311)
payment-adapter error-rate Datadog monitor muted until Oct 15 (PAY-441)
no monitor on handshake-failure rate or vendor chain changes
staging and CI integration tests use PayGate sandbox, which keeps the old chain until Oct 22
vendor status page said 'no customer action expected' (true only for default-trust clients)
